subject: Don't exit the process when locale-collate fails to be set from env during startup (#3067)
reason: The only behaviour change is at startup: when locale-collate is at its empty default and setlocale(LC_COLLATE, "") fails, the server now continues with the default locale instead of exit(1). That branch is taken only when the valkey-server process's own environment variables (LC_ALL/LC_COLLATE/LANG) name a locale the host lacks, and no fuzzer component can set environment variables for a server process: the only env knob is valkey.action.tools' per-run env, which applies to the tool process, and valkey-check-rdb/aof exit from main() before initServer runs, so they never reach the changed code.
